method: official documentation read, not DB experiment

sources.observation: Replica-filtered transactions still persist GTIDs; GTID membership alone does not prove that a particular table was populated or kept equivalent.
read_only has privileged-write exceptions and is a changeable setting; it is not a complete topology or historical integrity attestation.
Read-only routing concerns qualifying connection requests and current role-specific routing lists; application intent alone is not an invariant for an existing session through role changes.
